recommendation_basis: Predeclared conservative variant after mixed development results. Test is exploratory and previously inspected; no per-call selection from gold answers.
global_experiment_note: 27 of 35 selected long calls passed validation; eight retained v4 outputs. Several coding metrics regressed, and novelty known-topic false positives increased. Do not use full refinement as the default result.
novelty_note: Canonical aliases remove one known-topic false positive (128 to 127 of 545); withheld recall remains 11 of 30. No threshold changed.
review_note: Complete-call review remains 579 of 583; 387 have actionable issues and 192 have only unresolved evidence-gap issues. This does not establish labor savings.
